page.overview:
Who is Farore?

If with , arrives in seeking to rent out his . When speaks with , he will ask to let him know if he finds a woman willing to rent the . has the option to show any of the three the ; if he chooses or , will consider visiting them.

If the second is built and given to another , is left as the only one of the trio without a home, and will complains that she is alone.

If shows either of the to , she will move in; he can visit her afterwards, whereupon she will thank him and offer to give him whenever he has an . When consumed, the increases 's attack and defense, and turns his tunic (and ) purple for the duration of the effect. Although both attributes are increased, the offensive boost from and the defense boost from are higher.
